''See also: [[Eugan Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Eugan is a perceptive raven belonging to Feiora. He possesses the ability to communicate through caws and conveys specific messages or concerns, such as observations regarding [[Alin]], son of [[Torin]], or advice concerning [[Leah]]'s lack of allies and need for an advisor. He is a member of the [[Corvinus tribe]], which monitors its own members, and he traveled through the Gate alongside Feiora. To [[Leah]], Eugan serves as a companion and a source of guidance in an unfamiliar location. However, he is also linked to the [[Avernus]], and there is a suggestion that his [[Incarnation]] could be a dangerous entity.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Eugan is a raven. This bird typically rests upon Feiora's padded shoulder.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Eugan is a perceptive raven who shares a bond with Feiora, often resting upon her padded shoulder. Because of this connection, [[Leah]] instructs Feiora to ensure the bird's absolute safety. Associated with a [[Corvinus tribe]] lodge, Eugan serves as a guide for [[Leah]] within [[Avernus]]. This journey was initiated after the [[Avernus Incarnation]] requested that the raven accompany and lead [[Leah]] to the location.}}
